ComplexityText: While the process of creating Inset Gems is simple, identifying their best applications will take a diligently trained eye.
Description:
The Jeweler creates, infuses, and combines Inset Gems, which directly modify the statistics of equipment.
They are also skilled at working with Crystal and adjacent materials, producing aesthetic and vanity pieces, and locksmithing tasks.
CharacterDescription: People who receive the Jeweler's Brand have a connection, love or hate, to wealth and opulence. This connection heavily influences their life whether they're even aware of it. They may also be known for a discerning eye in any field they find themselves.
CharacterTraits: Presentation is important to me. The world should see me as accomplished.
Getting the fine details right is a virtue by itself.
My life being beautiful is just as important as it being functional.
SpecialSkillText: Jewelers can quickly spot differences in like objects and fine details that feel off, even in applications outside of craftsmanship.
InnateSkills: Mana manipulation using objects as conduits
ProgenitorLore:
Shuffling through the remains of her beloved home, Noa stifled a cold, quiet rage at the wonton violence. Every sign painted a more damning picture than the last. This wasn't a powerful creature, but an organized raid. They'd foolishly thought showing their civility through craft would be enough. Instead, it only brought thieves to their door.

Picking up a lavishly decorated banner, she swore. Never again would thieves come in the night for their valuables. If their craft wasn't enough to show their civility, she'd wear it. Any thief would have to stare at the rubies adorning her pauldrons and pry it from her cold, dead form - knowing they took from someone more intelligent, capable, and human than them.

Talents.Name: Crystalworking and Carving Expertise
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Mend, Salvage, and Refine items made of Crystal and Other-class materials.
Text: You can mend and salvage items and equipment made of Crystal or Other-class (such as wood or bone).
You’re capable of refining materials made of Crystal or Other-class materials at their full rate (see Crafting > Refining Materials).
You can also create many small things out of Crystal, or Other-class, such as ornaments, crystal balls, carvings of wood, latches, handles, or other similar objects in bulk.

Talents.Name: Essentia Infusion
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Infuse empty inset gems by harnessing the power of allies.
Text: You’re able to infuse empty Inset Gems with the powers of your party members or allies. Depending on the rank of the gem, you can hold more or less power.
Regardless of the capacity of the gem, the maximum infusion level can be no more than the tier of the gem. However, the infusion level can be less than the tier of the gem.

Talents.Name: Lapidary Artisanry
Text: In order to craft an Inset Gem of a given tier, you must expend 2 Crystal materials of at least that tier. The materials used must be of the same type.

Depending on the tier of the Inset Gem, you may make multiple at once. When you are assisted by the proper tools (a gem cutting workstation or inscribing table), you work twice as fast, and may make twice the amount of gems in the same time.
Tier 1: up to 6 per time slot
Tier 2: up to 4 per time slot
Tier 3: up to 3 per time slot
Tier 4: up to 2 per time slot
Tier 5 & 6: Only one per time slot

Talents.Name: Dual Infusion
Text: For an Inset Gem which is of greater quality than its infusion, you may infuse it with an additional effect, such that the total infusion level of both effects is less than the strength of the gem.
Because the act of infusing an already-infused gem is an incredibly complex balancing act, the action takes a very long time.
When taking actions to modify or move gems with multiple infusions, the amount of time it takes to do so is multiplied by the number of infusions.
The added infusion cannot be of the same type as any of the infusions already on the gem.

Talents.Name: Faceting
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Use additional materials to increase the price of items.
Text: When working on an item, you can use additional materials to make the design more intricate, or to add adornments to it. Using one material of your choice, you can implement one of the following effects:
Intricate: Using any material of your choice, you add materials to the equipment. Increase the price of the equipment by 25% of its original value.
Opulent: Using a precious material, such as silver, gold, or gemstones, increase the price of the equipment by 50% of its original value.
This ability may only be used once per craft.

Talents.Name: Extra Settings
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Add additional insets to an item while crafting.
Text: While crafting equipment, you may add an inset slot to the item.
This may be done a certain amount of times to an equipment equal to half its tier, rounded up.

Talents.Name: Greater Insets
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: You can work with higher tiers of inset gems, and work faster.
Text: When using Lapidary Artisanry, you can now create empty gems up to tier 9.
When using Essentia Infusion, your infusions can now be of up to tier 9.
When using Lapidary Artisanry, you can now operate faster and on higher tiers:
Tier 1: Up to 10 per time slot
Tier 2: Up to 8 per time slot
Tier 3: Up to 6 per time slot
Tier 4: Up to 4 per time slot
Tier 5: Up to 3 per time slot
Tier 6-7: Up to 2 per time slot
Tier 8-9: Only one per time slot

Talents.Name: Quality Combination
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Combine 2 of the same inset gem to make a gem of 1 tier higher.
Text: By taking two Inset Gems of the same type and rank, as well as an empty inset gem of one rank higher, you can perform a ritual of infusion, destroying the two lesser-ranked gems, while filling the higher ranked gem with an infusion of one rank higher.
If the Inset Gems’ housings are of the same tier as the rank you’re trying to create (if you put less power into the gems than they can hold), they aren’t consumed.

Talents.Name: Brilliance
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Expend more materials when crafting empty gems to increase their capacity.
Text: When crafting an empty Inset Gem, you may expend an additional material of the same type used to craft it.
By doing this, you’re able to add additional capacity to the gemstone. Depending on the amount of extra material used, you may further increase the capacity of the gemstone, irrespective of its tier.
Below is the total amount of materials which must be used in order to craft a gem with a given amount of extra slots.
1 Material: +0 capacity (normal)
2 Materials: +1 capacity
4 Materials: +2 capacity
7 Materials: +3 capacity
10 Materials: +4 capacity
